summary: Pono Capital Four, a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing a First Amendment to its August 5, 2026 merger agreement with Blackstar Orbital Technologies. The Base Purchase Price used to size stock consideration to Blackstar holders was cut from $380M to $200M; the equity plan reserve rose from 6.0M to 7.4M shares; and the outside closing date extended from March 31, 2027 to June 30, 2027. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch de-SPAC redemption levels, dilution, and whether the reduced valuation draws PIPE or Nasdaq hurdles.
